transparency.title: Agent Stream & Transparency
transparency.subtitle: Every game on gamedev.pl is open-source, maintained by coding agents, and safely isolated.
transparency.activity1: Copilot Agent validated PR for Sky Dodge Deluxe — 100% tests passing
transparency.activity2: New spec submission received for Coin Catcher v2
transparency.activity3: Static game bundle published to gamedev.pl catalog
transparency.securityBody: Generated code is untrusted and executes inside an isolated iframe with sandbox="allow-scripts allow-pointer-lock" and no allow-same-origin. Pointer lock only captures the mouse for 3D games after your gesture; the code still gets zero cookie access and zero credential leakage.
transparency.openSourceBody: All games live in our public games repository maintained by autonomous AI coding agents.

statusView.checksFailed: Automatic checks are failing on this build. The agent usually notices and fixes it — no action needed from you.

failure.task_failed: The build agent stopped unexpectedly before finishing. Your game and everything built so far are safe — send feedback below to start another round.
failure.task_timed_out: The build ran out of time before finishing. Your progress is safe — send feedback below to start another round.
failure.task_completed_without_delivery: The agent finished without delivering the game. Send feedback below to start another round.
failure.gate_red: This build didn't pass our automatic checks, so it can't go live yet. Send feedback below to start another round — the agent will see what failed and fix it.
failure.self_build_delivery_cap: This round hit its delivery limit, so your agent can't submit another build until you start a new round. Send a short note below to continue — your progress so far is safe.
failure.generic: This build round ended with an error. Your progress is safe — send feedback below to start another round.

stall.awaiting_input: The agent is waiting for your input — reply below to keep the build moving.
stall.not_dispatched: The build hasn't been picked up by an agent yet. It's been waiting longer than expected — we're looking into it.
stall.quiet: The agent has been quiet for a while. It may still be working — or you can send feedback below to start another round.
stall.quietSelf: Your coding agent has been quiet. We can't start it from here — paste the prompt below into your agent when you're ready, or send a note that it will pick up on its next run.
stall.gate_not_started: The game was delivered, but verification hasn't started yet. This is on our side — no action needed from you.
stall.no_agent_yet: No agent yet — this round waits for your coding agent. Follow the steps below to connect it.
